hook: YouTube Ad Punisher: Auto-reloads YouTube pages when an ad plays
hookText: YouTube Ad Punisher: Auto-reloads YouTube pages when an ad plays

beats.say: A small tool that automatically reloads a YouTube page whenever an ad starts playing, so playback resumes without sitting through the ad.
YouTube re-evaluates ad serving on each reload; after 1-2 cycles the ad slot is empty and the video plays clean.
Auto escape: after 3 reloads, the extension automatically switches to a helper tab for 4 seconds, then switches back.
